data.name: Chintoo
data.gender_notes: Chintoo is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘chin’ meaning thought and ‘tū’ meaning new or little. In Hindu mythology, Chintoo is a name given to the god Ganesha, the elephant-headed god of wisdom and intelligence. The name Chintoo carries the meaning “Thought, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chintoo usually hope their child will grow to embody thought, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, intelligence, and the power of thought.
data.etymology: Chintoo belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Thought, Intelligent.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chintoo total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Chintoo holds cultural significance in Hinduism, as it is a derived name for the revered deity, Lord Ganesha. Lord Ganesha is the god of wisdom and remover of obstacles. He is invoked at the beginning of any new endeavor to bestow his blessings of intelligence, wisdom, and success. The name Chintoo may be given to boy children, evoking the blessings of Lord Ganesha and his attributes of wisdom and intelligence.
data.spiritual_significance: In a spiritual context, the name Chintoo elicits devotion and reverence towards Lord Ganesha, reminding the bearer of the importance of wisdom, intelligence, and mental clarity in life. It is believed that Lord Ganesha imparts these qualities to his devotees, allowing them to overcome challenges and achieve their goals. The name Chintoo serves as a constant reminder to stay focused on spiritual growth and wisdom, and to seek the blessings of Lord Ganesha in all endeavors.
